summary: Davis Commodities Limited filed a Form 6-K and press release disclosing receipt of a final action letter from Nasdaq, confirming the Listing Council's decision to delist the Company's securities. Trading in Class A ordinary shares was suspended March 25, 2026; shares now quote on OTC Markets under DTCKF. The Company may appeal to the SEC under Section 19 of the Exchange Act. No terms, price, or premium stated. Watch for potential SEC appeal or further delisting procedures under Rule 12d2-2.
